_about: Pictures used by the READMEs and docs. Taken on a throwaway test server with a local model (qwen3.8 27B on Ollama), signed in as the example user Alex; no real data. test/phase114d.test.ts checks every referenced picture is listed here, exists and stays small.
method: Throwaway server (SARA_SETUP=off, a fresh SARA_DATA), Night look, 1440×900 desktop and 390×844 phone at 2×, cropped and saved as WebP (quality 80–82).
